consumers.usage: AUP 151. AUB is the authority for Offline Shared Workspaces, so it is this contract's primary consumer. internal/offlineworkspace/contract/ holds BYTE-FOR-BYTE copies of all six schema files, embedded with go:embed so the container image builds with no sibling checkout; TestEmbeddedContractIsExactlyAULIBS compares each against this package and fails the build on drift (it skips, loudly, when no sibling checkout is present). internal/offlineworkspace implements the role->capability lookup, the refusal taxonomy, the state machines with their guards, timestamps and idempotency identities, the durations and bounds, and the asset-type flags as READERS of that data rather than as transcriptions. TestCapabilityMatrixMatchesTheSharedFixtures and TestTransitionMatrixMatchesTheSharedFixtures run this package's fixtures/index.json — all 92 capability verdicts and all 199 transition cells — through the Go reader, so a Go/JavaScript disagreement fails AUB's own suite. TestOfflineAndRealtimeCapabilityModelsAreDistinct pins the Offline model against internal/membership's Real-time one: different version strings, same four role names, vocabularies disjoint apart from annotation.read and annotation.write. NO collections, routes, hooks or migrations were added; this task froze the contract only. No package file was changed by AUB; this row is the only write.

AUP 151. AUC participates in exactly one part of Offline collaboration - the escalation, where a workspace map becomes a linked Real-time session - and this is the vocabulary for that participation. src/offline-workspace/contract/ holds a byte-for-byte VENDORED copy of the six schema files, wired as ordinary JSON imports under resolveJsonModule, because this repository's Dockerfile runs npm ci from a build context of itself and a dependency resolving outside it fails there; the same arrangement it already has for vendor/incident-contract. src/offline-workspace/index.ts reads them: canOffline, offlineRolesWith, offlineNextStates, canOfflineTransition, offlineRefusalsFor, isOfflineRealtimeEligible, and the lease and escalation durations - the lease timeout in particular is read from here rather than from a local constant, because an escalation AUC is asked to accept must be checked against the SAME thirty minutes AUB used to decide the lease was still valid. test/offline-workspace-contract.test.ts compares all six files against this package, runs both shared matrices, and asserts that the Offline and Real-time capability vocabularies stay disjoint apart from the two annotation capabilities; it skips loudly with no sibling checkout. No room, handler or route was added. No package file was changed by AUC; this row is the only write.

AUP 151. frontend/src/collaboration/offlineWorkspace/contract/ holds a byte-for-byte VENDORED copy of the six schema files and contract.ts reads them: canOffline and offlineCapabilitiesFor for what the editor may OFFER, offlineRolesWith so refusal copy naming a role is read out of the table rather than written beside it, offlineNextStates/canOfflineTransition so a control is absent in a state AUB would refuse rather than present and failing, offlineReason/isOfflineReasonRetryable so a modal is chosen by code and never by matching on server prose, offlineLimit for field bounds, isOfflinePermittedUrl for description links, and the lease timeout so the editor's countdown and the moment AUB drops the lease are the same moment. IT IS VENDORED RATHER THAN DEPENDED ON: frontend/package.json's existing file: dependency on @auto-pigeon/incident-contract only builds because AUT resolves that package and passes it to docker build as a NAMED BUILD CONTEXT, and a second such dependency would need a second context wired in auto-pigeon-tools, which AUP 151 has no permission to change - a file: dependency with no context fails npm ci at image-build time rather than at development time, which is how the AUP image stayed unbuildable from ddf3bdf until AUP 127. src/test/offlineWorkspaceContract.test.ts compares all six files and runs both shared matrices, skipping loudly with no sibling checkout. NO pane, dialog, route or store was added; the Offline UI is a later task. No package file was changed by AUP; this row is the only write.
